brief:
Israeli soldiers beat a journalist who was covering a settler attack near Jericho, Al Jazeera English reported. The incident occurred as the journalist documented the confrontation between settlers and Palestinians in the area.

Journalists covering clashes between settlers and Palestinians in the West Bank have faced repeated physical attacks. The assault took place amid escalating tensions in the occupied territory.
dek: Israel’s army beat a journalist covering a settler attack near Jericho.
title: Israeli forces beat journalist covering settler attack near Jericho
